message:
Hi all! I've added you as collaborators on the private repo greenbot: https://example.org/git/greenbot. Accept the invite from the email or at https://example.org/git/greenbot/invitations (it expires in 5 days).

It's a small service that reads the soil sensors in the office and pings the team channel when a plant needs water. Use it to see which plants are dry, log a watering from the channel (/water fern-3) and get a weekly report. It only works on the office network.

Setup (details in the README):
  git clone git@example.org:greenbot.git && cd greenbot
  make deps && make build
  mkdir -p ~/.config/greenbot
  cp config.example ~/.config/greenbot/config   # set SENSOR_HOST
  chmod 600 ~/.config/greenbot/config
  make setup   # once: asks for the sensor hub password

setup gives each of you your own test channel (#greenbot-<user>), so you won't get in each other's way. Then run /health in the channel.

Feedback and PRs welcome. We use conventional commits.




This week I will keep working on it, it's only a first draft started on Monday, so it's still very rough.
